content: The CanTrcv module shall invoke the callback function CanIf_TrcvModeIndication , for each mode switch request with call to CanTrcv_SetOpMode , after the requested mode has been reached referring to the corresponding CAN transceiver with the abstract CanIf TransceiverId.
